critical_code_review_comments: server.py _resolve_role_for correctly precedences OWNER_EMAILS > invitation > current_role > first-user-owner — good design.
process_session recomputes role for existing users on every login — this means an owner env-listed user can never be demoted (correct per requirement).
/auth/me writes to DB only when role differs (line 174-176) — idempotent.

Invitation POST performs both existing-user role update AND upsert — even if user later re-invited, the invitation row still exists to reapply on future OAuth session for the same email (bit redundant but harmless).
Invitations use $set with the full doc (including a freshly generated invitation_id) on upsert, so the invitation_id CHANGES on every upsert (not ideal for audit but not a bug).
server.py is now ~752 lines — over the 700 recommended threshold. Consider extracting invitations + users routes into a routers/ module in next iteration.
Users.jsx bug (fixed) reveals a lack of pre-commit lint/typecheck. Recommend enabling ESLint no-undef rule in CI.
Invitation email is not validated with a strict regex — 'x@y' passes since 'in email:' check is only presence of '@'. Non-critical but could be tightened with pydantic EmailStr.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA of Users.jsx crash: When main agent added the Invite-by-Email feature, the JSX (dialog, table, button handlers) referenced state variables (inviteOpen, inviteForm, invites) and lucide-react icons (Mail, Plus) that were never declared at the top of the component. Because these are hoisted-check-failures at runtime (not compile-time in Babel), the module compiled successfully but the component threw ReferenceError on first render, causing React to unmount the entire page → blank screen. Reproduction: navigate to /team as owner — screen goes blank with pageerror 'Mail is not defined'. Mitigation applied: (1) added Mail, Plus to the lucide-react import line; (2) added three useState hooks: invites=[], inviteOpen=false, inviteForm={email:'',role:'accountant'}. Post-fix verified with Playwright — full invite flow works, no console errors.
